svg.text: Bars show trimmed means; dots show all 10 independent runs. Throughput and paired speed ratios retain
their original estimators. Sampling and weight sync are excluded. · The figure shows the ten-run
experiment and the separate single-process optimization experiment. The main test shows all independent
run values and trimmed means. Switch to paired speedups or the single-process optimization run. Protocols
remain separate; no confidence intervals are added. The static version shows main-test throughput.
